articles.title: Kraken ‘plans’ regulated perp contracts as rivals are quick off blocks
articles.snippet: In the wake of CFTC approval of perpetual futures contracts tied to the spot price of Bitcoin, Kraken expects to offer those to US institutional clients within "the next month."

articles.title: Bitcoin preps 3% May downside, but US PMI data may boost BTC price
articles.snippet: Bitcoin faced ending May lower by around 3%, with the possibility of US PMI data giving BTC price action a boost next week.

articles.title: Trump’s Business Partner Teases Future Meme Coin Plans: 'We’re The Biggest Brand on Earth'
articles.snippet: Bill Zanker, a longtime Trump associate, will take the top 19 holders of the president’s meme coin to the World Cup Finals next month—and has plans for ongoing exclusive events.
